summary: CASI Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K announcing that Mr. Wei (Larry) Zhang will no longer serve as Senior Vice President, a decision tied to previously disclosed efforts to streamline US operations. No financial terms, replacement, or advisor were disclosed. The departure is a senior executive change, though it appears routine in the context of restructuring. The filing is from the issuer itself. Watch for further operational restructuring announcements or potential cost-saving measures, though no deal or special situation beyond management transition is indicated.
